description: This file contains unit tests for the TelemetrySenderImpl class, verifying its behavior when sending messages via Proton in an Eclipse Hono client context. It includes tests for message sending outcomes, failure conditions, and timeout handling.

classes.name: TelemetrySenderImplTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the TelemetrySenderImpl class in different scenarios such as successful message send, failure due to lack of credit, and timeout handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSendMessageDoesNotWaitForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that the sender does not wait for peer acknowledgment and still succeeds when a message is rejected.

methods.name: testSendAndWaitForOutcomeFailsOnLackOfCredit
methods.description: Tests that sending fails immediately if no credit is available.

methods.name: testSendMessageFailsOnTimeout
methods.description: Ensures that a timeout during message sending results in the span being finished even if no acknowledgment is received.
